Commentary.Commentary: That is it from our side for this game. Windies go 1-nil up in the series as the play moves to Lauderhill, Florida. Join us for the same on Saturday at 2000 Local - 0000 GMT (5th August, Sunday). Till then, ciao!

Windies captain, Carlos Brathwaite, says that it was decided yesterday to start with Nurse first up. Adds that they had a gut feeling about the move and he feels happy that it came off nicely. Implies that he trusts his players to make the right calculative decisions in crunch moments and if they fail, they should look to improve in the next game. Ends by saying that they are happy with the win and would look to replicate the same performance in the next couple of matches as well.

Bangladesh captain, Shakib Al Hasan, starts by saying that they lost their way with the fall of early wickets. Adds that they kept on losing crucial wickets after every comeback they made but losing five in the first 10 overs was never going to help them. Asserts Windies have a lot of power-hitters in their team and they are well aware of them. Ends by saying they have a lot to improve and will look to rectify in the next match.

Earlier in the day, Bangladesh could never lift themselves after the initial setbacks. They lost 4 in the Powerplay as the Windies bowlers ran havoc, with the star being Williams who took a 4-fer to restrict the visitors for just 143. Mahmudullah was the highest scorer for the visitors with 35 but no one else could stick around for too long. During the Windies chase, wickets in heaps was what Bangladesh required. Rahman's double strike in the first over threatened, but no other bowler could do what was the need of the hour. It didn't really made any difference in the final outcome as the hosts go 1-0 up in the series.

Well, the score never looked like it would trouble the mighty Windies and they have made sure that they win this in a canter. The rain tried to play spoilsport by delaying the start of the second innings, but what a clinical performance this has been from the hosts as a whole. After a slight glitch in the second over, Russell and Samuels put on a 42-run stand and took the winds out of Bangladesh's sails. After the latter got out, Russell continued. He gave the visitors' bowlers a real pounding. He along with Powell chewed up the revised target of 91 with 11 balls to spare.
SIX! It's all over. What a strike to end things here at St. Kitts. It's a gentle floated ball on middle, Powell goes down on his knee to loft it over the long on fence. WINDIES WIN BY 7 WICKETS!
Shakib Al Hasan comes back for a bowl.
Slower ball outside off, Russ fails to connect with it. Still four needed as Rubel bowls a nice over.
Russell goes for the hook but misses the line of the delivery.

Ooh! That was so close. Powell manages to get bat to ball on this shortish delivery to get it towards covers. The fielder there has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Had he hit, it would have been close.
And again. Three in three. He hasn't connected to the similar deliveries outside his off stump.
Goes for a wild hoick off the length ball but misses.
Powell has attempted to put bat on ball but fails.
Rubel Hossain is back on.

SIX! Ho, Ho, Ho! Rusell is in Christmasy mood. It's raining sixes at the moment and a couple of them have gone out of the stadium as well. A tossed delivery from Islam, Russell stays in his crease and lofts it up and over and out of the park. Just 5 needed now.
Almost got him there. He bowls a yorker around off, Powell manages to get an inside edge to the on side. One run added to the total.
SIX! Fetched and fetched nicely. Now Powell gets into the act. A slow flighted ball on a length, Powell fetches it from off and deposits it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Another fast and full ball on middle and off, Russ powers it to long on and takes a run.
Faster and fuller on off, dug out to covers for nothing.
Punched down the ground for a run.
Nazmul Islam comes back for a bowl.
FOUR! 18 from the over! On the pads, Russell this time does not shuffle a lot and it becomes easy for him. He tickles it fine and the ball races away. 20 more needed from 24.
This is one length he struggles with. The bouncer. He ducks under it.

FOUR! This boundary probably seals it for the Windies. If it ever was in doubt. A short ball outside off, Russell with the angle cuts it over point and the ball races away. 14 from the last three balls.

SIX! Colossal! WOW! What a hit! That is bowled on a length around off, a similar one to the last ball. This time though it is on leg stump. Russell, lines it up and sends it sailing over the mid-wicket fence. 28 more needed.

FOUR! Full marks to the bowler there but runs to the batsman. Length ball on middle, it angles away from the batsman. Russell tries to go over mid-wicket but the ball takes the top edge and goes over short third man for a boundary.
A bumper on middle, Russell ducks under it. He looks at the square leg umpire for a wide but not given. A dot to begin.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on.
Gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out. End of a successful over for Hossain.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Rovman Powell is the next batsman in.

OUT! One hit too many from Samuels and he pays the price. A length ball on middle and off, he looks to loft it over long on once again but the connection isn't what he would've hoped for. Mahmudullah stations himself under the ball and takes an easy catch at the long on fence. Windies lose another as Bangladesh rejoice.
Andre gets an under edge to the full ball. The ball rolls behind the stumps towards fine leg. Samuels calls for a quick single and his partner obliges. A run completed.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Nicely punched off the back foot by Samuels. The ball races through covers and into the fence.
Five Wides! Rubel starts with a short ball in line of the stumps, Samuels goes for the hook but it's too high. The ball goes over the keeper's head and into the boundary.
Rubel Hossain is on.
Andre gets an inside edge and the ball hits him on the pads. End of an interesting over.
Rocks back and works it to the on side for a run.
SIX! No half measure from the big man. He is looking in ominous touch tonight. Another flighted ball on middle and powered to the wide long on fence for a huge one.
The ball has taken the inside edge of the bat and goes down the leg side. They pick up a single.

He survives! Uuf! That was close though. Shakib cleverly changes his length and pace and makes Russ play the false shot. He looks to play the sweep but misses it to get hit on his pad. Shakib feels it is out and cries out for a decision but the umpire is unmoved. He immediately takes the review. The replays roll in. No bat involved, it's pitching in line but just clipping the leg stump. It's umpire's call which means the original decision stays.
Review time! Andre Russell is the man in question for an LBW decision.

SIX! When he bats, the ground seems to get smaller. Shakib bowls a flatter delivery on middle and Russell pulls the trigger. It isn't that short but Russell turned it into a short ball and deposited over the mid-wicket fence.
Shakib Al Hasan is on.
Hangs back and keeps it out.
Leg Bye! On the pads, Andre misses the sweep to get rapped on his pads. A leg bye is stolen from the on side.
Played to the point region by Marlon. The batsmen have run through for a single.
SIX! Bang! What power! A floated delivery on middle, Samuels just lofts it ever so easily and deposits it over the mid-wicket fence for another maximum.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Tossed up delivery on off, Samuels lunges forward and drives it through covers. The fielder in the deep has to make an effort to get to that. He throws it back but couldn't stop the batsmen from taking a brace. A direct hit would have made things interesting but it wasn't to be.
Nazmul Islam is the first change.
Punched off the back foot by Russell. End of Powerplay with this. The match is evenly poised at the moment.
Fuller around off, driven to mid off. One run taken.

FOUR! This looked like a mere punch off the back foot but the timing has taken it all the way to the boundary. It was a tad shorter from Hasan on middle, Samuels stays back and punches it from there. The ball races to the mid-wicket fence for a boundary.
Wide!  Samuels tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The Umpire signals a wide.
Flighted around off, defended back to Hasan.
On the pads, worked to mid-wicket for a run.
Andre has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Marlon Samuels is in.

OUT! Gone! Two in one over. Similar start to that of the Windies for Bangladesh with the ball. What a star this guy is. So clever from him again. He bowls a back of a length ball, angling away from Fletcher, who failed to put bat to ball in the previous two occasions and is beaten by the pace this time. All he could manage to do is edge it to the keeper who says thank you.
Another play and a miss. Fletcher is in a hurry to finish this off but he isn't connecting them. Kudos to Rahman for mixing up the pace and length.
Goes for a wild hoick off the slower off cutter but misses.
Another short ball on middle, pulled just in front of the fielder at mid on.
Andre Russell is the next batsman.

OUT! In the air... and gone. Das takes an easy catch to dismiss Lewis. Fizz is into the act straightaway. He bowls a back of a length ball outside off, Lewis looks to pull it but ends up slicing it up in the air. The ball goes towards mid off and Das there takes an easy catch. Good start for Rahman and Bangladesh.
Lewis shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Mustafizur Rahman to share the new ball.
Played through mid-wicket by Lewis. The batsmen have run through for a single. 10 runs off the first over.
Bye! Backs away again to play it but Mehidy pushes it outside off. He misses the ball and it hits the keeper's pad to the fine leg region. A quick bye is stolen. A direct hit would have been tight.
SIX! Fletcher, you beauty. First maximum of the Windies innings and what a hit. He moves away to play the flighted delivery and lofts it handsomely over the long on fence.
Heaves the length ball to the on side and takes a run.
Pushes it into the left-hander who drives it back to him.
Starts with a faster ball outside off, Fletcher punches it to covers and changes strike.

After an elongated rain interval, we are back with the chase. A revised total of 91 runs in 11 overs has been set for the Windies. The players are out in the middle. Andre Fletcher and Evin Lewis is the opening duo while Mehidy Hasan will bowl the first over. Here we go...
